cn.t: Critics largely embrace this revamped West End production as a riotous improvement over its Broadway debut, with most praising its relentless gags and phenomenal cast, though a few dismiss it as dated and crude.

vr.q: If you can accept that, Young Frankenstein is a lot of fun. I give it four stars.
